title: CRIMSON VOWS: Villain Entry BGM (original score)
description:
The villain walks into his own wedding like he owns the whole hall. A swagger villain entry theme with handpan, nadaswaram and thavil, every hit landing like a punch.

For fans of mass villain BGM, South Indian wedding beats and slow-motion entry scenes. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Crimson Vows, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
